title: KNOWN_UPDATE_KEYS not co-located with Contact struct
description: KNOWN_UPDATE_KEYS is defined inside the process_update function body in contact.rs. The Contact struct lives in kith-store. A contributor who adds a new field to Contact has no co-location signal to remind them to update KNOWN_UPDATE_KEYS, and there is no compile-time enforcement. The list should be moved to a location adjacent to the field definitions, or a compile-time test should enumerate the Contact fields and assert they are either in KNOWN_UPDATE_KEYS or in an explicit exclusion list.
